changelog: Hogwarts Legacy & Universal Steam OTA Injection Hotfix v0.1.8
features: Resilient Host Executable Discovery: ConfigManager automatically discovers per-game profiles from host process executable directory, eliminating OTA config loss
Elevated DLL Deployment: vr-inject-cli automatically synchronizes and deploys updated vrinject.dll directly to protected game directories without stale downgrades
Profile Invariant Protection: Engine dependency synchronization preserves existing per-game vrinject.json without overwriting
OTA Profile Distribution: Dynamic over-the-air synchronization of curated game profiles to client AppData
fixes: Fixed Hogwarts Legacy and Steam titles failing to display in VR after OTA launcher push update
Fixed stale vrinject.dll from resourcesPath clobbering updated hotfixed engine binaries
Fixed ConfigManager defaulting to generic DX11 profile when injected from outside game directory
Fixed launcher profile search paths to include downloaded OTA profiles
